description: SLA support point spacing, head dimensions, and support-tree bridge/link-distance pipeline/consumer probes. Mutants are selected by their sole settings-variance test and must fail through ordinary assertions.

mutants.description: Ignore the configured support point spacing and force 1 mm. The active 8 mm generated-point profile must retain its public pairwise distance floor.
mutants.expected_oracle: The generated support points include a pair closer than the configured 8 mm spacing, so the ordinary pairwise spacing assertion fails.

mutants.description: Ignore the configured support front diameter during automatic point generation and force its default. The 1.2 mm profile must emit 0.6 mm-radius support points.
mutants.expected_oracle: The ordinary support-point radius assertion observes 0.2 mm instead of the configured 0.6 mm.

mutants.description: Ignore the configured SLA support head width and force the default. The active 0.5 mm config mapping assertion and independent wider-head geometry oracle must detect the change.
mutants.expected_oracle: The ordinary assertion comparing make_support_cfg output with the configured 0.5 mm head width fails.

mutants.description: Ignore the configured head width in the actual support-head filter and force the default width. The same-points 0.5-to-1.5 mm comparison measures valid-head width and head-only mesh volume, independent of pillar length or volume.
mutants.expected_oracle: The ordinary aggregate head-only mesh-volume assertion no longer increases for the 1.5 mm head, and the valid-head width assertion may also fail; total support volume is deliberately not used as a monotonic width oracle.

mutants.description: Ignore the registered maximum pillar link distance and force its default. With an 8 mm object elevation below the 15 mm solo-pillar threshold, the minimum 0 and below-spacing 2.9 mm rows must have no links between the two 3 mm-spaced pillars; 3.1 mm and the implicit default 10 mm must link both pillars.
mutants.expected_oracle: The ordinary linked_pillars assertions fail for the minimum and below-spacing rows when the mapping forces a 10 mm link limit.

mutants.description: Ignore the registered maximum bridge length and force its 15 mm default. The minimum and below-spacing rows must retain two independent pillars; the above-spacing and implicit-default rows must join the lower head to the upper center pillar through one routed bridge.
mutants.expected_oracle: The ordinary pillar_count and bridge_count assertions fail for the minimum and below-spacing rows when the mapping forces the default 15 mm value.
